instruction: A crisp, clean action photograph of a dance performance taken from a wide, eye-level angle. In a dance studio with dark gray walls and a warm wooden floor, two couples perform a synchronized lift. In the center foreground, the man in the rust-brown shirt (R1) bends forward at the waist, supporting the woman in the mustard yellow shirt (R2) horizontally on his back as she extends her left leg straight behind her. On the left, the man in the rust-brown shirt (R3) similarly bends forward to support the woman in the mustard yellow shirt (R4) on his back. On the right, a bystander couple in matching rust-brown and mustard-yellow attire performs the same lift. The scene is illuminated by even, soft studio lighting, highlighting the dancers' precise movements.
